desc:
🐉 RIDE A DRAGON 🐉
Hunt dragon eggs, catch them before other players do, hatch them and ride your own dragons across a huge fantasy world!

🥚 HUNT DRAGON EGGS
Fly over mountains, forests and floating islands to find dragon eggs. Carry them home before they break, and watch out: other players can steal your eggs!

🐣 HATCH & RIDE
Put eggs in your base to hatch them, even while you're offline. Then ride your new dragon and fly anywhere!

✨ EVERY DRAGON IS ONE OF A KIND
Each dragon hatches with its own pattern and float. The lower the float, the rarer the skin and the faster and richer your dragon.

🔥 MORE
* 17 dragon species, from Tidefin to the mighty Triscourge
* Hunt the legendary Glacius and Magmaroth eggs
* Eggs hatch 10x faster at night
* Feed and level up your dragons, boost your luck and rebirth
* Your dragons make money while you're offline

👍 Like and favorite for new dragons and updates!
🎟️ Codes: 2xluck · 2xhatchtime · galewing

🤝 Join the community for more!
